features.name: Basic Shopping Cart
features.description: Add/remove items, update quantities, view total price
best_practices: Enable bulk operations (select all, add multiple)
features.implementation_notes: Use Django sessions + PostgreSQL for persistence. Redis for caching.

features.name: Advanced Cart Features
features.description: Save for later, recommendations, comparison from cart, bulk checkout
features.implementation_notes: Leverage product relationships and purchase history data.

features.name: Mobile-Optimized Cart
features.description: Touch-friendly cart interface with swipe gestures
features.implementation_notes: Use CSS Media Queries and JavaScript touch events.

features.name: COD Checkout Flow
features.description: Cash on Delivery payment option - core payment method
best_practices: Progressive disclosure (one step at a time)
features.implementation_notes: Implement form validation, address verification, inventory locking.

features.name: Checkout Validation & Error Handling
features.description: Real-time form validation, error messages, fallback flows
best_practices: Validate on blur, not on keystroke
features.implementation_notes: Use Django forms, DRF serializers, and frontend validation.

features.name: Checkout Security Measures
features.description: CSRF protection, SSL/TLS, PCI compliance readiness
features.implementation_notes: Follow OWASP top 10, implement CSP headers, SameSite cookies.

features.name: Checkout Optimization & A/B Testing
features.description: Reduce friction, A/B test flows, optimize conversion
features.implementation_notes: Use feature flags for gradual rollout.

features.name: Order Creation & Storage
features.description: Create orders, lock inventory, generate order IDs
features.implementation_notes: Use Django's transaction.atomic() decorator.

features.name: Order Confirmation & Notifications
features.description: Send confirmation emails, SMS, update user dashboard
features.implementation_notes: Use Celery async tasks, Mailgun/SendGrid for emails.

features.name: Order Receipt & Invoice Generation
features.description: Generate PDF receipts, invoices for download/print
features.implementation_notes: Use WeasyPrint for HTML-to-PDF conversion.

features.name: Real-Time Order Status Tracking
features.description: Track order from confirmation through delivery
requirements: Order status states (pending, confirmed, shipped, delivered)
features.implementation_notes: Use Django signals for status changes, WebSockets for real-time.

features.name: Order Cancellation & Refunds
features.description: Allow order cancellation before dispatch, process refunds
features.implementation_notes: Implement finite state machine for order status.

features.name: Returns & RMA Management
features.description: Process returns, generate RMA numbers, track return shipments
features.implementation_notes: Integrate with shipping providers for return labels.

features.name: Order History & Dashboard
features.description: Display past orders, reorder, export history
features.implementation_notes: Use Django pagination, REST API for mobile.

features.name: Cash on Delivery (COD) - Current
features.description: Primary payment method - no pre-payment required
features.implementation_notes: Simple database flag. Focus on delivery partner integration.
success_metrics: Zero payment issues with delivery partners

features.name: UPI Payment (Future Phase)
features.description: Unified Payments Interface - India specific
features.implementation_notes: Use Razorpay or PayU for UPI.

features.name: Credit/Debit Card Payments (Future Phase)
features.description: Card payments with tokenization
best_practices: Use payment gateway for PCI compliance
features.implementation_notes: Partner with Razorpay or Stripe.

features.name: Digital Wallet Integration (Future Phase)
features.description: PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay
features.implementation_notes: Leverage payment gateway integrations.

features.name: Payment Gateway Infrastructure
features.description: Core payment processing infrastructure
features.implementation_notes: Recommend Razorpay for India market.

features.name: Shipping Carrier Integration
features.description: Integrate with major shipping providers (Delhivery, Bluedart, Ecom Express)
best_practices: Automatic carrier selection based on pincode
features.implementation_notes: Build abstraction layer for different APIs.

features.name: Real-Time Shipping Tracking
features.description: Display shipping location and ETA
features.implementation_notes: Poll carrier APIs every 30 minutes with Celery.

features.name: Shipping Time & Cost Estimates
features.description: Calculate and display delivery estimates at checkout
best_practices: Show time range not exact date
features.implementation_notes: Cache rates for 24 hours for performance.

features.name: Shipping Label Generation
features.description: Generate and print shipping labels for fulfillment
features.implementation_notes: Generate on order confirmation.

features.name: Return Shipping Integration
features.description: Generate return labels, track return shipments
best_practices: Free return shipping for eligible returns
features.implementation_notes: Integrate with carrier return services.

features.name: User Authentication & Registration
features.description: Email/phone registration, login, password reset
features.implementation_notes: Use Django's built-in auth with custom User model.

features.name: User Profile Management
features.description: Edit name, email, phone, profile picture
features.implementation_notes: Use Pillow for image processing.

features.name: Address Management
features.description: Save multiple addresses, set default delivery address
features.implementation_notes: Use Google Places API for autocomplete.

features.name: User Preferences & Settings
features.description: Language, currency, notifications, privacy settings
best_practices: Account deletion with data retention policy
features.implementation_notes: Store preferences as JSON in user model.

features.name: Security Settings & Account Protection
features.description: Two-factor auth, login history, device management
features.implementation_notes: Use django-otp for TOTP support.

features.name: Basic Product Search
features.description: Search products by keywords
features.implementation_notes: Start with PostgreSQL full-text, migrate to Elasticsearch if needed.

features.name: Advanced Search & Filtering
features.description: Filter by category, price, brand, rating, etc.
features.implementation_notes: Use Elasticsearch facets for dynamic filter counts.

features.name: Sorting & Result Ordering
features.description: Sort by relevance, price, rating, newest, bestselling
features.implementation_notes: Implement in Elasticsearch query.

features.name: Quick View Modal
features.description: Preview product in modal without navigation
features.implementation_notes: Use Bootstrap modal or custom lightweight modal.

features.name: Product Comparison Tool
features.description: Compare products side-by-side
best_practices: Quick add to cart from comparison
features.implementation_notes: Use responsive table or carousel for mobile.

features.name: Core Product Details Page
features.description: Display product info, images, price, stock status
features.implementation_notes: Use responsive image gallery.

features.name: Product Variants (Size, Color, etc.)
features.description: Select size, color, quantity before adding to cart
features.implementation_notes: Use AJAX to update images and price.

features.name: Product Reviews & Ratings
features.description: Display reviews, ratings, helpful votes, filters
best_practices: Show only verified purchase reviews prominently
features.implementation_notes: Build review moderation workflow.

features.name: Product Recommendations & Related Items
features.description: Show related products, frequently bought together
features.implementation_notes: Implement collaborative filtering and content-based filtering.

features.name: Review Submission & Moderation
features.description: Allow users to write and submit product reviews
features.implementation_notes: Use Celery for moderation tasks.

features.name: Review Analytics & Insights
features.description: Track review metrics, trends, buyer behavior
features.implementation_notes: Use NLP for sentiment analysis.

features.name: Wishlist / Saved Items
features.description: Save products for later purchase, share wishlist
features.implementation_notes: Simple many-to-many relationship.

features.name: Wishlist Price & Availability Notifications
features.description: Alert users to price drops, back in stock
features.implementation_notes: Daily batch job to check prices.

features.name: Basic Mobile Responsiveness
features.description: Mobile-friendly layout, touch optimization
features.implementation_notes: Use Bootstrap 5 responsive utilities.

features.name: Mobile Navigation & Menu
features.description: Hamburger menu, bottom navigation, mobile UX
features.implementation_notes: Use Bootstrap offcanvas for drawer.

features.name: Mobile-Optimized Checkout
features.description: One-page or minimal-step mobile checkout
features.implementation_notes: Use HTML5 input types for smart keyboards.

features.name: Progressive Web App (PWA) Considerations
features.description: App-like experience, offline support, install prompts
features.implementation_notes: Create comprehensive PWA implementation.

features.name: SSL/HTTPS & Data Encryption
features.description: Secure all connections with SSL/TLS certificates
features.implementation_notes: Use Let's Encrypt for free SSL.

features.name: OTP Email/SMS Verification
features.description: Two-factor authentication for account security
best_practices: Option to switch method (email to SMS)
features.implementation_notes: Use django-otp library.

features.name: Address Validation & Verification
features.description: Verify delivery addresses are real and serviceable
features.implementation_notes: Use Google Places Autocomplete + Address Validation API.

features.name: PCI DSS Compliance (Future Phase)
features.description: Prepare infrastructure for payment card compliance
features.implementation_notes: Outsource PCI compliance to payment gateway.

features.name: Email Confirmation & Security Emails
features.description: Send transactional emails with verification links
features.implementation_notes: Use Django's signing module for tokens.

features.name: Admin Order Dashboard
features.description: View, manage, and process orders
features.implementation_notes: Extend Django admin or build custom dashboard.

features.name: Inventory Management System
features.description: Track stock levels, manage inventory
features.implementation_notes: Implement inventory locking during checkout.

features.name: Shipping Management Interface
features.description: Manage shipments, print labels, track deliveries
features.implementation_notes: Build wrapper around carrier APIs.

features.name: Analytics & Business Reporting
features.description: Dashboard with key metrics, trends, insights
features.implementation_notes: Use analytics library like Metabase or build custom.

features.name: FAQ Bot & Automated Support
features.description: Answer common questions automatically
features.implementation_notes: Start with rule-based FAQ, evolve to ML-based.

features.name: Live Chat Integration
features.description: Connect customers with support agents
features.implementation_notes: Use Intercom or Zendesk Chat.

features.name: Chatbot - Order Status Queries
features.description: Allow users to track orders via chat
features.implementation_notes: Extend FAQ bot with order API integration.

features.name: Multi-Language Support (Future Phase)
features.description: Support multiple languages on platform
features.implementation_notes: Use Django i18n framework.

high_risk_areas.mitigation: Use established payment gateway (Razorpay), implement fraud detection
SSL/TLS, OTP, input validation, regular security audits
Real-time inventory sync, automated alerts, forecasting

conclusion.summary: This roadmap provides a comprehensive path to building a production-ready e-commerce platform competitive with Amazon, Shopify, and AliExpress. The phased approach allows for MVP launch in 2 months with iterative additions of features.
key_success_factors: Build trust through reviews, ratings, security
Focus on data analytics for continuous improvement
Build in scalability from the start
next_steps: Review and prioritize features based on business goals
